assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase4b_off_the_shelf_closers_eliminated
assertions.source: C₂/Σln h not dominance-monotone (U-shaped); FKG eliminated (f not log-supermodular, fails k=8); Chebyshev eliminated (~77% concordant). Interval reduction stands but lowers dimension power only; Cov_β(C₂,ln f)≤0 on [2,3] open. No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 4b of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631): test the two off-the-shelf closers for the Phase-4 interval reduction Cov_β(C₂,ln f)≤0 on [2,3], and CORRECT two Phase-4 over-statements. CORRECTION 1: C₂ and Σln h are NOT dominance-monotone — both are conjugation-invariant and U-shaped (large at row/column extremes, small in the middle). ROUTE FKG (needs (f^λ)^β log-supermodular on the dominance lattice): ELIMINATED — f is log-supermodular for k≤7 but FAILS at k=8 (λ=(4,2,1,1),μ=(3,3,2): f_λf_μ=3780>f_∨f_∧=3136). ROUTE Chebyshev (needs C₂,Σln h comonotone): ELIMINATED — only ~77–80% pairwise concordant (systematic discordant family (m,2) vs (m,1,1)). CORRECTION 3: the reduction does NOT sidestep the dimension — Σln h=ln k!−ln f still contains the log-dimension (∉ Ivanov–Olshanski algebra A); it lowers the dimension POWER (from (f)³-weighting to a ln f-covariance), a genuine simplification but not an escape. NET: the interval reduction stands; both off-the-shelf correlation-inequality closers fail; Cov_β(C₂,ln f)≤0 on [2,3] remains open. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.dimension_not_sidestepped_note: Sln h = ln k! - ln f; still the log-dimension, not in algebra A
